name: Customer
description: A person or organization with a potential, current or former customer relationship with the business.

properties.name: Party type
properties.description: Whether the customer is an individual or an organization.

properties.name: Lifecycle stage
properties.description: The overall commercial relationship, independent of account status. A prospect is a qualified lead; a former customer previously had an established customer relationship.

properties.name: Lead temperature
properties.description: Current interest or engagement, independent of qualification. Omit when unknown or not applicable.

properties.name: Qualification stage
properties.description: The qualification reached by a lead or prospect. Omit when unknown or not applicable.

properties.name: Account status
properties.description: The operational account state, independent of lifecycle, billing and payment state. Set explicitly when creating an account.

properties.name: Commercial model
properties.description: How the account is offered. Free means no payment is expected; freemium offers a free tier with paid upgrades. None means no commercial offering applies.

properties.name: Billing stage
properties.description: The account billing relationship. Cancellation does not itself end access or close the account. For multiple subscriptions this is an account summary; individual subscription states remain separate.

properties.name: Payment status
properties.description: Whether account payment obligations are met. None means no obligation applies; current means obligations are met; past due means a payment is overdue; delinquent means it meets the business's escalation policy. This is an account summary when several subscriptions exist.

properties.name: Test account
properties.description: True for an account used for testing rather than a real customer relationship.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name shown for this customer.

properties.name: Primary contact
properties.description: The main person to contact: the customer themselves for an individual, or their representative for an organization.

properties.name: Organization
properties.description: The organization, when the customer is one.

properties.name: Addresses
properties.description: Keyed by role, such as billing or shipping.

properties.name: Timezone
properties.description: IANA timezone identifier, such as Europe/London.

actions.name: Update customer
actions.description: Change customer details. Use change_status or change_lifecycle for account status and lifecycle changes.

actions.name: Status change
actions.description: Change account status without changing the lifecycle stage.

actions.name: Lifecycle change
actions.description: Change lifecycle stage without changing account status.

events.name: Lifecycle changed
events.description: The commercial relationship moved to another lifecycle stage.
